text:
maya: heads-up — starting a planned keystore->KMS binding for vault/staging in ~30m. purpose: retire legacy wrapping key and reduce blast radius. need an RBAC precheck and confirmation that audit writes will be preserved during the window.

sam: on it. which k8s service accounts will get the keystore-unseal role?

maya: svcaccs for canary: vault-unsealer-stg only. later: batch-workers, partner-sync (but partner-sync is blocked until we verify isolation). plan: grant iam.kmsCryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter on projects/infra/keys/vault-wrap to vault-unsealer-stg SA and create a vault role mapping for wrapping entitlement.

leo: please do NOT add partner-sync yet. can we run token_scoped leases for partner traffic instead of direct key access?

maya: yep, canary will be vault-unsealer-stg only. partner-sync will be postponed.

ana: audit note — Fluentd had recent drops in staging. i'll spin up an S3 fallback buffer for audit logs during the window. sec-bot, can you check audit-forwarder health?

sec-bot: audit-forwarder status: degraded — last successful delivery 9m ago, retrying. @ana please run: `kubectl -n observability rollout status deploy/audit-forwarder`

ana: running now. logs show 502 to s3-proxy, switching endpoint to backup and restarting the deploy.

sam: RBAC precheck results:
`kubectl auth can-i create secrets --as=system:serviceaccount:platform:vault-unsealer-stg`
result: yes
also checked IAM binding: `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy vault-wrap --project=infra | grep vault-unsealer-stg || true`
(so far no binding, will add in next step)

maya: great. can we also add a deny role for partner-sync to make sure partner never accidentally gets secret create access? please post the policy yaml.

leo: quick deny stub (will refine):
```yaml
apiVersion: rbac.authorization.k8s.io/v1
kind: Role
metadata:
  name: vault-keystore-deny
rules:
- apiGroups: [""]
  resources: ["secrets"]
  verbs: ["*"]
```
We'll gate with OPA to exclude the vault-unsealer-stg SA. I'll open a brief change to the gate repo.

ana: audit-forwarder is now healthy, backup S3 active. timeline unchanged.

maya: starting canary migration in 5m. runbook steps: 1) create KMS grant 2) rotate wrap key version 3) update Vault transit config to new key 4) smoke unseal on canary SA 5) monitor audit + traces.

sam: expected failure modes?

maya: likely: audit lag causing missed events; unsealer failing to decrypt if IAM grant missing; RBAC forbidding token creation; stale key versions/policy mismatch. rollback plan: remove grant, revert vault transit config to previous key id, restart unsealer agents.

sec-bot: incident created: INC-2026-0423-keystore-rollout (link: https://incidents.redwood/INC-2026-0423). tagging oncall.

ana: ping me when you see audit entries for transit/decrypt and transit/encrypt. I'll verify the event hashes and that we have no blanks.

maya: canary migration complete. smoke unseal passed. sample log:
[smoke] 2026-03-23T15:02:13Z vault-unsealer-stg: unseal ok
no errors in last 2m.

leo: good. i'll open PR for OPA exclude and the RBAC deny role; will include tests that assert partner-sync cannot create secrets.

sam: suggest we schedule partner-sync cutover next week after full audit verification and a KMS cross-project attestation exercise.

maya: agreed. booking follow-up runbook and marking partner cutover as high review overhead / low risk after checks.

nana: closing audit buffer — i'll upload buffered events to long-term store and attach checksums to the incident.

maya: thanks team :thumbsup:
